scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frameworks/react --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frameworks/solid --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frameworks/svelte --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frameworks/vue --noEmit && tsc -p packages/frameworks/angular --noEmit
scripts.test:browser: pnpm test:react && pnpm test:solid && pnpm test:svelte && pnpm test:vue
scripts.test:react: pnpm --dir packages/frameworks/react exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project react-browser
scripts.test:solid: pnpm --dir packages/frameworks/solid exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project solid-browser
scripts.test:svelte: pnpm --dir packages/frameworks/svelte exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project svelte-browser
scripts.test:vue: pnpm --dir packages/frameworks/vue exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --project vue-browser
scripts.test:poc: for package in poc/*; do if [ -f "$package/package.json" ]; then pnpm --dir "$package" install --ignore-workspace --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir "$package" --ignore-workspace test || exit $?; fi; done
